maintenance: Curated official-source calendar, verified 26 October 2026 against the Fiscal Data release calendar API (Monthly Treasury Statement), the BEA news release schedule, the BLS CPI and Employment Situation schedules, the Federal Reserve FOMC calendar and Treasury's most recent quarterly refunding documents. channelNote: Fiscal channels are explanatory mechanisms identified by Fiscal Space, not official costings or quantified CBO baseline revisions.
